subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should interrupted subagent announce delivery turns be reconciled as non-running `killed` sessions and always run tool-free across CLI, embedded, and Codex native paths?
rationale: The patch fixes the observed cascade, but it changes persisted session-state semantics and a tool-execution boundary that require maintainer ownership before merge.

options.title: Accept this model
options.body: Rerun or clear `check-lint`, then land this PR with `announceLastRun`, non-running `killed` reconciliation, and tool-free announce delivery as the approved invariant.

options.title: Choose another terminal state
options.body: Keep the classifier and tool isolation, but change the recovery reconciliation from `killed` to the maintainer-approved non-running state before merge.

options.title: Pause for broader delivery design
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want a generic inter-session delivery recovery model instead of an announce-specific persisted marker.

recommendation.title: Accept this model
recommendation.body: Rerun or clear `check-lint`, then land this PR with `announceLastRun`, non-running `killed` reconciliation, and tool-free announce delivery as the approved invariant.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent restart recovery lifecycle and transcript/session-state work makes this the closest available owner for the persisted recovery decision.
